Subject: Tenant activation: Acropolis Health — initial access plan

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get the tenant for Acropolis Health stood up this week. I wanted to capture a short plan so we can align on who we should invite, how we'll seed API credentials, and what projects/roles you prefer.

Summary / asks:
- Confirm two initial org admins we should invite (name + email).
- Confirm project naming convention (we propose: acropolis-prod / acropolis-staging).
- Let us know if you require customer-managed KMS or the Redwood-managed key for the initial seed.
- We’ll seed a short-lived service account key for the implementation and rotate after you verify access.
- Proposed provisioning window: Thu 11/12 10:00–11:30 PT. Tell us if another time works.

Attachments: Acropolis-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (seeded plan + role matrix).

If all good, Monica will trigger the invites and David will create the service account and seed keys to a secure link.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

- Samantha Green <samantha@acropolishealth.com> (Primary)

Thanks — can do the 11/12 slot if you keep it to 60–75 minutes.

Best,

Quick internal sync — notes from Samantha’s reply and proposed owner assignments: 

1) Admin invites (owner: Monica) — invite Samantha and Mark as org admins. Set their role to Admin + Billing (Samantha) and Admin + Developer (Mark). Target: 11/12 10:05 PT.
2) Projects (owner: David) — create acropolis-staging and acropolis-prod namespaces. Set staging limits to 2 concurrent workers for initial testing.
3) Seeded credentials (owner: David) — generate a service account + short-lived key. Proposal: 14-day TTL. Store key on secure link and mark as ROTATE=after verification.
4) SSO onboarding (owner: Lauren) — confirm Okta SAML mapping for the two admins; if not possible immediately, create local invites with prompt to switch to SSO later.
5) Security review (owner: Connor) — review the attached Acropolis-Security-Reqs.pdf and list any non-blockers.

Checklist (to close before kickoff):
- [ ] Admin invites sent
- [ ] Staging + Prod projects created
- [ ] Service account key seeded and secure link created
- [ ] Okta mapping validated or local invites created
- [ ] Short walkthrough scheduled (calendar invite)
